annotation.title_clean: Se realizó el encuentro “Oportunidades y desafíos en Inteligencia Artificial”
annotation.title_en: The meeting "Opportunities and Challenges in Artificial Intelligence" was held
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agencia I+D+i / Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Argentina)
annotation.summary_en: Argentine government news item on a workshop held by the Science Ministry, Agencia I+D+i and the IDB on AI opportunities and challenges, with sector tables on agroindustry, bioinformatics, logistics and mining. It announces a US$35 million IDB-backed AI investment programme; no robotics or regulatory content.
key_provisions_or_claims: IDB agreement of US$35 million to invest in AI applications in agriculture, medical equipment, industry and education
Agencia I+D+i aims for an integrated AI programme; FONTAR has 22% of projects linked to AI
Sector working tables identified limits: public-private-academic articulation, scarce skilled staff, data/compute and ethical responsibility
National CTI Plan 2030 includes AI as an axis
Public-private consortia call to be shaped by workshop conclusions
